tasks.goal: Research native Rust inference support for TypeSafe/System One decision model families (Laya, d1, Clef, Tev1, Nimble, Kev, PPLX-DECIDER). Determine which exact checkpoint formats/architectures and licenses exist, whether they can run without Ollama in Candle or another embeddable runtime, official APIs/repos, and model size/resource requirements. Use primary sources and cite links. Do not change any files or download model weights. Deliver capability matrix and hard constraints.

Inspect Plaesy CLI architecture and recommend the smallest safe implementation slice for a new `plaesy decisions` command with Plaesy-owned model location/config/list/pull/infer. Identify exact relevant files, config conventions, CLI parse dispatch/tests, Hugging Face download library already present, test strategy and pitfalls. Do not edit files, do not run model download or mutate repo. Check dirty worktree and avoid reading secrets.
